hook.name: OrketHook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook for binary prediction market pools that computes VALS dynamic fees (e^[λ·Δx/L·σ]−1) per swap using a backend-signed toxic-velocity parameter, routing collected USDC fees to a YieldDistributor for share token holders. Requires valid signed hookData (SignedSigma) on every swap; reverts if absent, expired, or replayed.
